trails.title: Coffee meets code
trails.blurb: Follow a microcontroller interest into the unexpected world of espresso-machine tinkering.
notes: The same electronics craft appears in espresso-machine tinkering.
Machine modifications connect back to the craft of brewing espresso.

trails.title: Tiny worlds, living systems
trails.blurb: From miniature landscapes to terrariums and underwater gardens, then the water they share.
notes: Dioramas and terrariums both compose a landscape in a small space.
Terrariums connect to aquascaping, where the miniature landscape moves underwater.
Aquascaping and coffee water share an interest in measuring and adjusting water.

trails.title: Circuits into sound
trails.blurb: A circuit-board project opens into modular synthesizers and the world of sound-shaping pedals.
notes: PCB design and modular synthesizers share tools and materials for building circuits.
Modular synthesizers connect to effects pedals through a shared interest in shaping sound.

trails.title: From birds to galaxies
trails.blurb: Let an interest in watching wildlife lead through photography to the night sky.
notes: Birdwatching connects to photography through observing and recording wildlife.
Photography also underpins astrophotography, with a very different subject overhead.
Deep-sky imaging is one branch of astrophotography to explore.

trails.title: From the table to the page
trails.blurb: Follow the writing behind a tabletop game into small, personal publications.
notes: Running a tabletop game draws on writing and storytelling.
Zines are another outlet for that writing: small publications with room for niche interests.

trails.title: Signals, sabers & sound
trails.blurb: Explore the electronics connecting radio listening to illuminated props and custom sound.
notes: Software-defined radio listening draws on electronics.
Pixel sabers use that same craft in an illuminated prop.
Custom soundfonts are a connected branch of the pixel-saber hobby.
